StartDisasterRecovery.name: StartDisasterRecovery
StartDisasterRecovery.description: 该接口用于启动容灾操作。 容灾状态为“未启动”、“启动失败”和“已停止”时可以执行启动容灾操作。 启动容灾后,生产集群和灾备集群将无法进行恢复、扩容、升级、重启、节点替换、更新密码等操作,此外,灾备集群将无法进行备份操作,请谨慎操作。 当容灾启动后,如果灾备集群容灾正常运行且容灾处于恢复状态中,此状态的集群会计费。 仅支持DWS 2.0集群。

SwitchFailoverDisaster.name: SwitchFailoverDisaster
SwitchFailoverDisaster.description: 该接口用于容灾异常场景下进行主备集群切换操作。 “异常切换”按钮用于容灾异常或者生产集群故障情况下主备切换操作。 容灾异常切换仅8.1.2及以上集群版本支持。 异常切换会将灾备集群升为主,若原生产集群故障后存在部分数据未同步到灾备集群,那灾备集群升主后将缺少这些数据,切换时请确认容灾最后同步时间,谨慎操作。 仅支持DWS 2.0集群。

SwitchOverCluster.name: SwitchOverCluster
SwitchOverCluster.description: 当集群状态为“非均衡”时会出现某些节点主实例增多,从而负载压力较大。这种情况下集群状态是正常的,但整体性能要低于均衡状态。可进行集群主备恢复操作将集群状态切换为“可用”状态。 **约束限制**: 集群主备恢复仅8.1.1.202及以上版本支持。 集群主备恢复将会短暂中断业务,中断时间根据用户自身业务量所决定,建议用户在业务低峰期执行此操作。

SwitchoverDisasterRecovery.name: SwitchoverDisasterRecovery
SwitchoverDisasterRecovery.description: 该接口用于容灾进行灾备切换操作。 “灾备切换”按钮用于在容灾正常情况下主备倒换操作。 容灾状态为“运行中”时可以执行灾备切换操作。 灾备切换需要一定时间,在此期间,原生产集群将不可用。 不同场景下进行灾备切换,RPO(Recovery Point Object,灾难发生后,系统和数据必须恢复到的时间点要求。)说明如下: 生产集群在“可用”的状态下,RPO=0。 生产集群在“不可用”的状态下,无法保证RPO=0,但数据至少可恢复到生产集群“最近容灾成功时间”。 仅支持DWS 2.0集群。

UpdateLogicalCluster.name: UpdateLogicalCluster
UpdateLogicalCluster.description: 编辑修改逻辑集群。接口根据提交的请求体判断当前操作是逻辑集群缩容或者扩容。 场景一:原始的逻辑集群有6个节点(两个环),提交请求时的请求体只有1个环,此时为逻辑集群缩容。 场景二:原始的逻辑集群有6个节点(两个环),提交请求时的请求体中有3个环,此时为逻辑集群扩容。 此接口已经不再演进,后续版本中可能会下线,新版本中此接口对应功能已经下线。

BatchUpdateByAdmin.name: BatchUpdateByAdmin

CheckoutUndoByAdmin.description: 管理员通过此接口撤销指定M-V模型实例的检出,将实例数据还原至检出前的内容。

CollectHistoryData.description: 输入指定模型的统计时间区间(开始时间和结束时间),即可获取该模型的统计数据,包含创建实例、删除实例、软删除实例和更新实例的数据。在调用该接口前请确保数据模型具有“系统版本”功能。

CompareBusinessVersion.name: CompareBusinessVersion
CompareBusinessVersion.description: 通过此接口可以对比某个M-V模型数据实例的不同版本的属性和关系。建议使用数据建模引擎(xDM Foundation,简称xDM-F)新增的差异对比功能,即使用instance-attrs-comparison和instance-relation-comparison接口,更多内容可在应用运行态的“数据服务管理 > 全量数据服务 > 系统管理API > 属性对比API”中查看。

CompareVersion.name: CompareVersion
CompareVersion.description: 通过此接口可以对比某个模型数据实例的不同版本的属性和关系。建议使用数据建模引擎(xDM Foundation,简称xDM-F)新增的差异对比功能,即使用instance-attrs-comparison和instance-relation-comparison接口,更多内容可在应用运行态的“数据服务管理 > 全量数据服务 > 系统管理API > 属性对比API”中查看。在调用该接口前请确保数据模型具有“系统版本”功能。

ListAimTemplateReports.description: 根据用户指定过滤条件查询指定智能信息模板的解析次数。当日数据需要次日16:00之后才能查询到。

ListResolveTasks.description: 创建解析任务后,客户可以查询解析任务状态信息。 通过模板ID等过滤条件,查询解析任务列表。 如需查询明细,建议使用查询解析明细接口。

SendAimBatchDifferentMessages.name: SendAimBatchDifferentMessages
SendAimBatchDifferentMessages.description: 该接口用于向不同用户发送不同内容的短信。 - 前提条件 1. 已创建短信应用。 2. 已申请短信签名,获取签名通道号。 3. 已申请短信模板,获取模板ID。 - 注意事项 单条短信最多允许携带500个号码,每个号码最大长度为21位。

SendAimBatchMessages.name: SendAimBatchMessages
SendAimBatchMessages.description: 向单个或多个用户发送相同内容的短信。 - 前提条件 1. 已创建短信应用。 2. 已申请短信签名,获取签名通道号。 3. 已申请短信模板,获取模板ID。 - 注意事项 最多允许携带500个号码,每个号码最大长度为21位。

SetPrimaryVideoThumbnail.name: SetPrimaryVideoThumbnail
SetPrimaryVideoThumbnail.description: 根据用户提供的视频封面图资源ID和AIM视频资源ID设置视频模板的封面图。

ShowAimMsgSignatureFileInfo.name: ShowAimMsgSignatureFileInfo

ShowAimMsgTemplateDetail.description: 该接口用于用户获取已创建的短信模板详情。

ShowAimMsgTemplateVariable.description: 该接口用于用户查询短信模板变量。

ShowTemplateVideoThumbnail.name: ShowTemplateVideoThumbnail
ShowTemplateVideoThumbnail.description: 根据用户提供的过滤条件,查询视频模板封面图资源列表。

UpdateAimMsgApp.name: UpdateAimMsgApp
UpdateAimMsgApp.description: 该接口用于用户修改短信应用。

UpdateAimMsgSignature.name: UpdateAimMsgSignature
UpdateAimMsgSignature.description: 该接口用于用户更新短信签名信息,目前仅支持审核不通过的短信签名重新修改。

UpdateAimMsgTemplate.name: UpdateAimMsgTemplate
UpdateAimMsgTemplate.description: 该接口用于用户修改短信模板信息,目前仅支持审核不通过的短信模板重新修改。

UpdateMenu.name: UpdateMenu
UpdateMenu.summary: 修改智能信息服务号菜单
UpdateMenu.description: 支持用户修改所属企业的指定菜单。

UpdatePersonalTemplateState.name: UpdatePersonalTemplateState
UpdatePersonalTemplateState.description: 根据用户提供的模板ID,启用或禁用智能信息个人模板。

UpdatePortalInfo.name: UpdatePortalInfo
UpdatePortalInfo.description: 用户对已创建的主页进行信息的修改。

UpdatePubInfo.name: UpdatePubInfo
UpdatePubInfo.description: 支持用户更新服务号信息。

UploadAimMsgSignatureFile.name: UploadAimMsgSignatureFile
UploadAimMsgSignatureFile.description: 该接口用于用户上传创建短信签名所需的营业执照/授权委托书文件。

UploadAimTemplateMaterial.name: UploadAimTemplateMaterial
UploadAimTemplateMaterial.summary: 上传智能信息模板素材
UploadAimTemplateMaterial.description: 支持用户上传模板使用的图片或者视频。 > 单个租户资源空间为10GB,包括回收站内容,请及时清理无用资源,防止资源浪费。 > 请求中所有字符串不允许携带“<”、“>”或多个空格。

UploadMedia.name: UploadMedia
UploadMedia.summary: 上传智能信息服务号图片资源
UploadMedia.description: 支持用户上传图片资源。

AsyncInvokeInstance.name: AsyncInvokeInstance
AsyncInvokeInstance.description: 实例执行异步命令接口。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 可以通过调用该接口实现对自己的koophone云手机实例进行异步adb指令操作。 调用完该接口后携带该接口返回的task_id去调用实例执行任务查询接口。

BatchBackupInstances.name: BatchBackupInstances
BatchBackupInstances.description: 实例数据批量备份到OBS,然后释放物理实例。 调用此api的前提条件是实例数据已还原到物理机。

BatchPrepareInstances.name: BatchPrepareInstances
BatchPrepareInstances.description: 实例批量准备。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 调用该接口后,当前实例会被准备到可以串流的状态。

BatchRebootInstance.name: BatchRebootInstance
BatchRebootInstance.description: 调用此接口可以批量重启云机实例。

BatchResetInstance.name: BatchResetInstance
BatchResetInstance.description: 实例批量重置, 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 调用该接口后,当前实例会被初始化。

BatchShowInstance.name: BatchShowInstance
BatchShowInstance.description: 实例状态批量查询。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 接口返回实例当前的状态:云机状态,0:未知,1: 已停止,2:运行中,3:下线中,4:启动中, 5:已关机。

BatchShowSku.name: BatchShowSku
BatchShowSku.description: 实例sku批量查询。 接口返回租户下所有可售实例的规格信息。 根据query参数去查询具体的商品的sku信息。

CancelInstance.name: CancelInstance
CancelInstance.description: 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 将云机取消分配给租户指定的用户,调用后会清除用户云机使用数据。

CreateInstance.name: CreateInstance
CreateInstance.description: 租户可以通过调用该接口生成实例。 该接口需要结合BatchShowSku接口一起使用,在BatchShowSku接口中获取全量的可售的sku。租户根据自己需要去选择相应规格进行订购。 调用该接口时如果想要直接购买成功,请您先在账户上充值并在订购参数中选择isAutoPay为自动付费。 如果没有选择自动付费,在调完接口后请拿对应的订单号去您账号的待支付订单中选择手动付费。

DeleteInstance.name: DeleteInstance
DeleteInstance.description: 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 租户可以调用该openapi退订已经订购的包周期实例,不可以退订按需的实例。

ExecuteInstanceAuthToken.name: ExecuteInstanceAuthToken
ExecuteInstanceAuthToken.summary: 租户实例串流前获取设备的device_token
ExecuteInstanceAuthToken.description: 租户实例串流前获取设备的device_token, 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 调用该接口获取云机实例的device_token后作为鉴权信息,并携带云机实例的device_id去调用返参中的信令地址(signaling_url)。

ExecuteJob.name: ExecuteJob
ExecuteJob.description: 实例执行任务批量查询。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 该接口需要和实例执行异步命令接口一起使用,使用实例执行异步命令接口返回的task_id作为路径上的参数以此获取异步命令执行的结果。 同时,该接口也可以和实例安装app接口一起使用,使用实例安装app接口返回的task_id作为路径上的参数,以此获取实例安装app的执行结果。 实例安装app接口返回的task_id有固定前缀“ZGCA”或者“FULFILL”,和实例执行异步命令接口返回的task_id有所区分。

InstallApp.name: InstallApp
InstallApp.description: 调用此接口可以向云机实例批量安装app。 接口返回当前安装任务的task_id,此task_id有固定前缀“ZGCA”。 用户根据返回的task_id,调用GetTask实例执行任务查询接口去查询执行结果。

ListInstanceApp.name: ListInstanceApp
ListInstanceApp.description: 实例安装应用列表查询。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买实例。 接口返回租户实例中安装的应用列表信息。

ListInstances.name: ListInstances
ListInstances.description: 实例批量查询。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 接口返回租户下所有实例信息。

ProvisionInstance.name: ProvisionInstance
ProvisionInstance.description: 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 将云机分配给租户指定的用户,需要指定用户userId。

SetVideo.name: SetVideo
SetVideo.description: 实例视频设置。 调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。 使用该接口可以设置实例每一个清晰度对应的码率和出流的帧率。

ShowProgress.name: ShowProgress
ShowProgress.description: 实例准备进度。 调用此api的前提条件是需要先调用prepare接口。 循环调用此接口直到云机状态为正常则可开启串流。

StopInstancesSession.name: StopInstancesSession
StopInstancesSession.description: 串流停止后会话还会存续一段时间,此接口可提供释放。

StopInstancesStreaming.name: StopInstancesStreaming
StopInstancesStreaming.description: 停止实例串流,若不在串流中的实例则无效果。

SyncInvokeInstance.name: SyncInvokeInstance
SyncInvokeInstance.description: 实例执行同步命令接口。调用此api的前提条件是租户需要先购买koophone云手机实例。可以通过调用该接口实现对自己的koophone云手机实例进行adb指令操作。 该接口是同步操作接口,如果有耗时adb操作建议使用实例执行异步命令接口。

AssociateKeypair.name: AssociateKeypair
AssociateKeypair.description: Binds an SSH key pair to a specified VM. (The private key of the SSH key pair for the VM is required if you want to replace the key pair, but not required if you want to reset the key pair.)

BatchAssociateKeypair.name: BatchAssociateKeypair
BatchAssociateKeypair.summary: Binding SSH Key Pairs in Batches
BatchAssociateKeypair.description: This interface is used to bind new SSH key pairs to specified VMs in batches.

BatchExportPrivateKey.name: BatchExportPrivateKey
BatchExportPrivateKey.summary: Exporting private keys of key pairs in batches.
BatchExportPrivateKey.description: Exporting private keys of key pairs in batches. A maximum of 10 records can be exported at a time.

BatchImportKeypair.name: BatchImportKeypair
BatchImportKeypair.summary: Import SSH Key Pairs in Batches.
BatchImportKeypair.description: Import SSH key pairs in batches. A maximum of 10 SSH key pairs can be imported at a time.

ClearPrivateKey.name: ClearPrivateKey
ClearPrivateKey.description: Clear the private key of the SSH key pair.

CreateKeypair.description: Creating and Importing an SSH Key Pair

DeleteKeypair.name: DeleteKeypair
DeleteKeypair.description: This API is used to delete an SSH key pair.

DisassociateKeypair.name: DisassociateKeypair
DisassociateKeypair.description: Unbinds an SSH key pair from a specified VM and restores SSH password login.

ExportPrivateKey.name: ExportPrivateKey
ExportPrivateKey.description: Export the private key of a specified key pair.

ImportPrivateKey.name: ImportPrivateKey
ImportPrivateKey.summary: Accessing the page for importing private keys
ImportPrivateKey.description: Import the private key to the specified key pair.

ListFailedTask.name: ListFailedTask
ListFailedTask.description: Queries information about failed tasks, such as binding and unbinding tasks.

ListKeypairs.name: ListKeypairs
ListKeypairs.summary: Querying the SSH Key Pair List
ListKeypairs.description: Querying the SSH Key Pair List

ListKeypairTask.name: ListKeypairTask
ListKeypairTask.description: Queries the execution status of the current task based on the task ID returned by the SSH key pair API.

UpdateKeypairDescription.name: UpdateKeypairDescription
UpdateKeypairDescription.description: This API is used to update the description of an SSH key pair.

BatchGetKv.name: BatchGetKv
BatchGetKv.description: 批量读请求,其中可以携带一或多个表的不同kv的查询操作。

BatchWriteKv.name: BatchWriteKv
BatchWriteKv.description: 批量写请求,其中可以携带一或多个表的不同kv的写操作,上传kv/删除kv。

CheckHealth.name: CheckHealth
CheckHealth.description: 网络信道健康检查,返回response未抛出网络异常即为成功

CreateTable.description: 在指定仓内创建表,表名在仓内唯一;创建表时,指定主键模板及本地二级索引模板及全局二级索引模板。创建表时,如果仓不存在,将会自动创建仓。

DeleteKv.name: DeleteKv
DeleteKv.description: 指定表,指定主键,删除该文档;允许指定条件执行。

DeleteTable.name: DeleteTable

DescribeTable.name: DescribeTable

ListTable.name: ListTable
ListTable.description: 指定仓列举创建的所有表。

PutKv.name: PutKv
PutKv.description: 指定表,新建kv或覆盖已有kv,且满足表的key schema描述;允许指定条件执行。

ScanKv.name: ScanKv
ScanKv.description: 指定表,扫描表下所有kv;允许指定过滤条件。

ScanSkeyKv.name: ScanSkeyKv
ScanSkeyKv.description: 指定表及分区键,携带条件查询kv;允许指定过滤条件。

UpdateKv.description: 指定表,指定主键,指定更新文档的部分内容,如果是自描述文档,指定字段名;如果是二进制文档,指定偏移位置和长度;允许指定条件执行。

CreateTrainingBasicJob.name: CreateTrainingBasicJob
CreateTrainingBasicJob.summary: 创建基础版语音训练任务
CreateTrainingBasicJob.description: 用户创建语音训练基础版任务,该接口会返回一个obs上传地址,用于上传语音文件。 支持2种方式上传语音文件: * 语音文件和文本文件打包成zip上传:语音文件已经切分成20个wav文件,每个语音文件对应一个txt文本文件,所有文件打包成zip文件。语音文件命名规则:0.wav~19.wav;文本文件命名规则:0.txt~19.txt。 * 语音文件和文本文件逐句上传:每次上传一句语料的语音文件和文本文件,再调用“确认在线录音结果”接口确认语音和文本内容是否一致。确认成功后再上传和确认下一句。 文件上传后,调用“提交语音训练任务”接口,启动审核和训练。

CreateTrainingMiddleJob.name: CreateTrainingMiddleJob
CreateTrainingMiddleJob.summary: 创建进阶版语音训练任务
CreateTrainingMiddleJob.description: 用户创建语音训练进阶版任务,该接口会返回一个obs上传地址,用于上传语音文件。 支持2种方式上传语音文件: * 语音文件和文本文件打包成zip上传:语音文件已经切分成100个wav文件,每个语音文件对应一个txt文本文件,所有文件打包成zip文件。语音文件命名规则:0.wav~99.wav;文本文件命名规则:0.txt~99.txt。 * 语音文件和文本文件逐句上传:每次上传一句语料的语音文件和文本文件,再调用“确认在线录音结果”接口确认语音和文本内容是否一致。确认成功后再上传和确认下一句。 文件上传后,调用“提交语音训练任务”接口,启动审核和训练。

BatchReinstallServer.description: Rebuilds servers in batches. > - When a server goes abnormal and cannot be restored, or goes down after running for a long time, the server can be rebuilt with the original image. This operation will clear the system disk data.

BatchRejoinDomain.name: BatchRejoinDomain
BatchRejoinDomain.summary: Rejoining Servers to a Domain in Batches
BatchRejoinDomain.description: Rejoins servers to the AD domain in batches, which is used for servers out of the domain.

BatchUpdateTsvi.name: BatchUpdateTsvi
BatchUpdateTsvi.summary: Updating Virtual Session IP Configurations on the Server in Batches
BatchUpdateTsvi.description: Updates virtual session IP configurations on the server in batches, which requires server reboot.

BatchUpgradeHdaVersion.name: BatchUpgradeHdaVersion
BatchUpgradeHdaVersion.summary: Upgrading the HDA Version of Servers in Batches
BatchUpgradeHdaVersion.description: Upgrades the HDA version of servers in batches.

BindAppWarehouseBucket.name: BindAppWarehouseBucket
BindAppWarehouseBucket.summary: Adding a User Application Repository Bucket and Authorizing Access to the Bucket
BindAppWarehouseBucket.description: Adds a user application repository bucket and authorizes access to the bucket.

ChangeCluster.name: ChangeCluster
ChangeCluster.summary: Switching the Cluster to Which a Folder Belongs
ChangeCluster.description: Switches the cluster to which a folder belongs.

ChangeServerImage.name: ChangeServerImage
ChangeServerImage.description: Modifies the server image. > - If the server image differs from the server group image, the server image can be switched to the server group image. Only for images under the same circumstances such as OS, free version, and paid version (source & price). Or you can purchase new servers, or delete or unsubscribe from ol…

CheckAppGroup.name: CheckAppGroup
CheckAppGroup.description: Checks whether an application group meets the specified rules. 1. Checks whether an application group name meets the naming rules. 2. Checks whether an application group name is duplicate.

CheckPublishApp.name: CheckPublishApp
CheckPublishApp.description: Verifies the application to be published. Applications with the same name cannot be published.

CheckQuota.name: CheckQuota
CheckQuota.description: Verifies the quota. Before purchasing a server, you can call this API to check whether the server resources are sufficient.

CountImageSubJobs.name: CountImageSubJobs
CountImageSubJobs.summary: Querying the Number of Image Subtasks
CountImageSubJobs.description: Queries the number of asynchronous subtasks. If **job_type** is not specified, the total number of subtasks whose **JobType** is **CREATE_SERVER|CREATE_SERVER_IMAGE|DELETE_SERVER** is queried.

CountSubJobs.name: CountSubJobs
CountSubJobs.description: Queries the number of asynchronous subtasks.

CreateAppGroup.name: CreateAppGroup
CreateAppGroup.description: Creates an application group. > - Different applications are installed on an application server. These applications can form different application groups for centralized management and maintenance and be published to users or user groups.

CreateBucketOrAcl.name: CreateBucketOrAcl
CreateBucketOrAcl.summary: Adding a Bucket or Authorizing Access to a Bucket
CreateBucketOrAcl.description: Adds a bucket or authorizes access to a bucket.

CreateCloudStorage.name: CreateCloudStorage
CreateCloudStorage.description: Creates project configuration association. Currently, only project configuration association is supported.

CreateHotspotSessionConfig.name: CreateHotspotSessionConfig
CreateHotspotSessionConfig.description: Creates a hotspot session migration configuration.

CreateOrUpdateScalingPolicy.name: CreateOrUpdateScalingPolicy
CreateOrUpdateScalingPolicy.summary: Adding or Modifying an Auto Scaling Policy
CreateOrUpdateScalingPolicy.description: Adds or modifies an auto scaling policy. Only pay-per-use servers support this operation.

CreateOrUpdateStoragePolicyStatement.name: CreateOrUpdateStoragePolicyStatement
CreateOrUpdateStoragePolicyStatement.summary: Adding or Updating a Custom Policy for Storage Directory Access Permissions
CreateOrUpdateStoragePolicyStatement.description: Adds or updates a custom policy for storage directory access permissions (if a custom policy exists, the existing policy will be updated).

CreatePersistentStorage.name: CreatePersistentStorage
CreatePersistentStorage.description: Creates Workspace storage. Currently, only SFS 3.0 Capacity-Oriented file systems can be created.

CreatePolicyGroup.name: CreatePolicyGroup
CreatePolicyGroup.description: Adds a policy group. Policy groups can be used to control client access policies for files, clipboards, and sessions.

CreatePolicyTemplate.name: CreatePolicyTemplate
CreatePolicyTemplate.description: Add a policy template. After a policy template is created, you can adjust the configuration based on the existing policy template when creating a policy group.

CreateServerGroup.name: CreateServerGroup
CreateServerGroup.description: Creates a server group. > - A server group is a set of servers of the same configurations. The servers are created using the same image and they are running the same applications. When a user opens a cloud application, an available server is scheduled to be connected.

CreateServerGroupTags.name: CreateServerGroupTags
CreateServerGroupTags.description: The API is idempotent. If the request body contains duplicate keys, an error is reported. During tag creation, duplicate keys are not allowed. If a key already exists in the database, its value will be overwritten by the new duplicate key. A server group can contain a maximum of 20 tags.

CreateUserFolderAssignment.name: CreateUserFolderAssignment
CreateUserFolderAssignment.description: If the directory of the personal folder to create already exists, only the policy is updated and the directory is not created repeatedly.

CreateWarehouseApp.name: CreateWarehouseApp
CreateWarehouseApp.summary: Adding an Application to the Application Repository
CreateWarehouseApp.description: Adds an application to the application repository.

DeleteAppGroup.name: DeleteAppGroup
DeleteAppGroup.description: Deletes a specified application group. If the operation is performed repeatedly, a success response (HTTP status code 200) is returned.

DeleteAppIcon.name: DeleteAppIcon
DeleteAppIcon.description: Deletes a custom application icon and restores the default application icon. If the operation is performed repeatedly, a success response (HTTP status code 200) is returned.

DeleteCloudStorage.name: DeleteCloudStorage
DeleteCloudStorage.description: Deletes shared storage. Only the association between NAS and project configuration is removed.

DeleteCloudStorageAttachment.name: DeleteCloudStorageAttachment
DeleteCloudStorageAttachment.description: After a personal storage directory is deleted, the data in the personal storage directory is permanently deleted and cannot be restored.

DeletePersistentStorage.name: DeletePersistentStorage
DeletePersistentStorage.description: Deleting the shared storage only removes the association between the NAS and the file system, and does not delete the file system or data in the file system.

DeletePolicyGroup.name: DeletePolicyGroup
DeletePolicyGroup.description: Deletes specified policy groups, including their policy information and application objects.

DeletePolicyTemplate.name: DeletePolicyTemplate
DeletePolicyTemplate.description: Deletes a specified policy template, including the policy information and application object information corresponding to the policy template.

DeleteScheduleTask.name: DeleteScheduleTask
DeleteScheduleTask.description: Deletes a task. Tasks that do not exist are ignored and a response indicating successful operations will be returned.

DeleteServer.name: DeleteServer
DeleteServer.description: Deletes a server. Servers that do not exist are ignored and a response indicating successful operations will be returned. This API is called after an order is unsubscribed.

DeleteServerGroups.name: DeleteServerGroups
DeleteServerGroups.description: Deletes a server group. - > Before deleting a server group, delete all the servers in it. If this operation repeats, a successful message returned.

DeleteServerGroupTags.name: DeleteServerGroupTags
DeleteServerGroupTags.description: The API is idempotent. During tag deletion, if some tags to delete do not exist, the deletion is considered successful by default. The character set of the tags will not be checked. The tag structure cannot be missing, and the key cannot be left blank or an empty string. A maximum of 20 tags can be deleted at a time.

DeleteStorageClaim.name: DeleteStorageClaim
DeleteStorageClaim.description: Deletes a shared storage directory. A shared file directory can be deleted only after the bound user and user group are deleted.

DeleteUserStorageAttachment.name: DeleteUserStorageAttachment
DeleteUserStorageAttachment.description: After a personal storage directory is deleted, the data in the personal storage directory is permanently deleted and cannot be restored.

DeleteWarehouseApp.name: DeleteWarehouseApp
DeleteWarehouseApp.summary: Deleting a Specified Application in the Application Repository
DeleteWarehouseApp.description: Deletes a specified application in the application repository.

DisassociateAppGroup.name: DisassociateAppGroup
DisassociateAppGroup.summary: Disassociating a Service Group from All Application Groups
DisassociateAppGroup.description: Disassociates a service group from all application groups.

InitializeTenant.name: InitializeTenant
InitializeTenant.summary: Activating and Initializing a Tenant Service

ListAccessAgentLatestVersion.name: ListAccessAgentLatestVersion
ListAccessAgentLatestVersion.summary: Querying the Latest Versions of All HDAs of a Tenant
ListAccessAgentLatestVersion.description: Queries the latest versions of all HDAs of a tenant.

ListAppGroup.name: ListAppGroup
ListAppGroup.description: Queries created application groups by name or authorization type.

ListAppGroupAuthorization.name: ListAppGroupAuthorization
ListAppGroupAuthorization.description: Queries authorized users of an application.

ListAuthorizationMailRecord.name: ListAuthorizationMailRecord
ListAuthorizationMailRecord.summary: Querying Records of Sending Emails on Application Group Authorization
ListAuthorizationMailRecord.description: Queries records of sending emails on application group authorization.

ListAvailabilityZone.name: ListAvailabilityZone
ListAvailabilityZone.description: Queries AZs where Huawei Cloud Workspace is available.

ListCorpConfigInfo.name: ListCorpConfigInfo
ListCorpConfigInfo.description: Configuration loading sequence: Queries enterprise-level configurations. If no configurations are found, the default Apollo configuration will be used. If no Apollo configurations are found, there will be no response.

ListFoldersAndFiles.name: ListFoldersAndFiles
ListFoldersAndFiles.description: Queries folders and files in a specified directory.

ListImageJobs.name: ListImageJobs
ListImageJobs.summary: Querying the Image Tasks of a Tenant
ListImageJobs.description: Queries the execution status of asynchronous tasks of a tenant.

ListImageSubJobs.name: ListImageSubJobs
ListImageSubJobs.description: Queries the execution status of an asynchronous subtask. If **sub_job_ids** is not empty, **offset** and **limit** do not take effect.

ListLatestAttachedServerApp.name: ListLatestAttachedServerApp
ListLatestAttachedServerApp.summary: Querying Information About the Latest Distributed Software
ListLatestAttachedServerApp.description: Queries information about the latest distributed software. The returned ID list does not contain specific information.

ListNonMigrationUsers.name: ListNonMigrationUsers
ListNonMigrationUsers.summary: Querying Users Not Migrated from Hotspot Sessions
ListNonMigrationUsers.description: Queries users who are not migrated from hotspot sessions.

ListPolicyGroup.name: ListPolicyGroup
ListPolicyGroup.description: Queries the brief information of a policy group, including the application object and policy items.

ListPolicyGroupDetailInfo.name: ListPolicyGroupDetailInfo
ListPolicyGroupDetailInfo.description: Policy information and target object information.

ListPolicyOfPolicyGroup.name: ListPolicyOfPolicyGroup
ListPolicyOfPolicyGroup.summary: Querying Policy Items of a Policy Group
ListPolicyOfPolicyGroup.description: Queries policy items of a specified policy group.

ListPolicyTemplate.name: ListPolicyTemplate
ListPolicyTemplate.description: This interface is used to query the brief information list of a policy template, including the policy information and application object information. When creating a policy group, you can adjust the configuration based on the existing policy template to quickly create a policy group.

ListProduct.name: ListProduct
ListProduct.description: Queries Application Streaming packages by filtering based on conditions.

ListServerGroupTag.name: ListServerGroupTag
ListServerGroupTag.summary: Querying Resource Tags of a Tenant in All Server Groups
ListServerGroupTag.description: Queries the resource tag set of a tenant in all server groups.

ListServerHdaDetails.name: ListServerHdaDetails
ListServerHdaDetails.summary: Querying HDA information of a Server
ListServerHdaDetails.description: Queries HDA information of a server.

ListServerHdaUpgradeRecords.name: ListServerHdaUpgradeRecords
ListServerHdaUpgradeRecords.summary: Querying HDA Upgrade Tracing Records of a Server
ListServerHdaUpgradeRecords.description: Queries HDA upgrade tracing records of a server.

ListServerMetricData.name: ListServerMetricData
ListServerMetricData.summary: Querying the Monitoring Data of a Metric of a Specified Granularity in a Specified Time Range
ListServerMetricData.description: Queries the monitoring data of a metric of a specified granularity in a specified time range.

ListStoragePolicyStatement.name: ListStoragePolicyStatement
ListStoragePolicyStatement.summary: Querying Access Permission Policies of a Storage Directory
ListStoragePolicyStatement.description: Queries access permission policies of a storage directory.

ListSubJobs.name: ListSubJobs
ListSubJobs.description: Queries the execution status of an asynchronous subtask. If **sub_job_ids** is not empty, **offset** and **limit** do not take effect.

ListTargetsOfPolicyGroup.name: ListTargetsOfPolicyGroup
ListTargetsOfPolicyGroup.summary: Querying Target Objects of a Policy Group
ListTargetsOfPolicyGroup.description: Queries application objects of a specified policy group.

ListTaskExecuteDetail.name: ListTaskExecuteDetail
ListTaskExecuteDetail.summary: Querying Executed Subtasks of a Scheduled Task
ListTaskExecuteDetail.description: Queries executed subtasks of a scheduled task.

ListTenantServerGroups.name: ListTenantServerGroups
ListTenantServerGroups.summary: Querying Basic Information About a Tenant Server Group
ListTenantServerGroups.description: Queries basic information about a tenant server group (used to bind server groups when creating an application group).

ListWarehouseApps.name: ListWarehouseApps
ListWarehouseApps.summary: Querying Applications in a Tenant Application Repository
ListWarehouseApps.description: Queries applications in a tenant application repository.

PublishApp.name: PublishApp
PublishApp.description: Publishes application in batch. Any name duplicate is not allowed.

RecreateServerImage.name: RecreateServerImage
RecreateServerImage.description: Creates an Application Streaming image. * This operation is supported only by instances that are running properly or do not have ongoing image tasks.

ReinstallServer.name: ReinstallServer
ReinstallServer.description: Reinstalls a server. > - When a server goes abnormal and cannot be restored, or goes down after running for a while, the server can be reinstalled with the original image. Note: The reinstallation will reset the system disk.

ResetUserProfile.name: ResetUserProfile
ResetUserProfile.description: Resets the userprofile, including initializing or resetting the userprofile, and backing up the userprofile.

SendAuthorizationMail.name: SendAuthorizationMail
SendAuthorizationMail.summary: Resending an Email on Application Group Authorization (Based on Authorization Email Records)
SendAuthorizationMail.description: Resends an email on application group authorization (based on authorization email records).

SendAuthorizedMail.name: SendAuthorizedMail
SendAuthorizedMail.summary: Resending an Email on Application Group Authorization (Based on Authorization Records)
SendAuthorizedMail.description: Resends an email on application group authorization (based on authorization records).

ShowAccessAgentLatestVersion.name: ShowAccessAgentLatestVersion
ShowAccessAgentLatestVersion.summary: Querying the Latest HDA Version of a Tenant
ShowAccessAgentLatestVersion.description: Queries the latest HDA version of a tenant.

ShowHdaUpgradeFlag.name: ShowHdaUpgradeFlag
ShowHdaUpgradeFlag.description: Queries the HDA upgrade notification flag (only for internal access).

ShowImageJob.name: ShowImageJob
ShowImageJob.description: Queries the execution status of an asynchronous task, such as an image instance creation task.

ShowImageServer.name: ShowImageServer
ShowImageServer.description: Queries whether the data of this API in the specified image instance is the same as that queried by **list**.

ShowJob.name: ShowJob
ShowJob.description: Queries the job execution status. **job_id**, which is returned after the creation of an Application Streaming server starts. **job_id** can be used for querying the job execution status.

ShowJobDetail.name: ShowJobDetail
ShowJobDetail.description: Queries task execution statuses. After a command of an asynchronous API (for creating an ECS, deleting an ECS, or rebuilding an image) is delivered, a job ID is returned, based on which you can query the execution status of the task.

ShowOriginalPolicyInfo.name: ShowOriginalPolicyInfo
ShowOriginalPolicyInfo.description: Queries initial policy items. An initial policy item is the default configuration of all protocol configuration items. Users can modify the initial policy item as required to create a new policy group.

ShowPolicyGroup.name: ShowPolicyGroup
ShowPolicyGroup.description: Queries details about a policy group by policy group ID, including the policy information and target object information.

ShowPublishableApp.name: ShowPublishableApp
ShowPublishableApp.description: Queries publishable applications in an application group.

ShowScalingPolicy.name: ShowScalingPolicy
ShowScalingPolicy.summary: Querying Auto Scaling Policies of a Server Group
ShowScalingPolicy.description: Queries auto scaling policies of a server group. If no policy is configured for the server, the default policy is returned.

ShowScheduleTask.name: ShowScheduleTask
ShowScheduleTask.summary: Querying Details About a Specified Scheduled Task
ShowScheduleTask.description: Queries details about a specified scheduled task.

ShowServer.name: ShowServer
ShowServer.description: Queries whether the data of this API in the specified server is the same as that queried by **list**.

ShowServerGroupState.name: ShowServerGroupState
ShowServerGroupState.summary: Querying Server Status of a Specified Server Group
ShowServerGroupState.description: Queries the server status of a specified server group.

ShowServerGroupTag.name: ShowServerGroupTag
ShowServerGroupTag.description: Queries the tag information about a specified server group.

ShowServerMetricData.name: ShowServerMetricData
ShowServerMetricData.summary: Querying Monitoring Information of an Application Streaming Server
ShowServerMetricData.description: Queries data (such as the CPU usage, memory usage, and period when a user is online) of a desktop in a time range (from 1 hour to 30 days). The data can be retained for up to 180 days.

ShowServerVnc.name: ShowServerVnc
ShowServerVnc.summary: Obtaining a VNC Remote Login Address
ShowServerVnc.description: Obtains a VNC remote login address.

TransferFile.name: TransferFile
TransferFile.description: Cloud storage file transfer and sharing

TransferFilePre.name: TransferFilePre
TransferFilePre.description: Pre-transfers a file. An available file path is returned before the recipient receives the file.

UnpublishApp.name: UnpublishApp
UnpublishApp.description: Unpublishes applications in batches. > - This operation also removes the authorization on these applications. If the operation is repeated, the operation is successful (response code 200 is returned).

UpdateNonMigrationUsers.name: UpdateNonMigrationUsers
UpdateNonMigrationUsers.summary: Updating Users Not Migrated from Hotspot Sessions
UpdateNonMigrationUsers.description: Updates the users who are not migrated from hotspot sessions. When adding users, existing entries are overwritten. When deleting users, missing entries are skipped.

UpdatePolicyTemplate.name: UpdatePolicyTemplate
UpdatePolicyTemplate.description: Modifies information about a specified policy template.

UpdateServer.name: UpdateServer
UpdateServer.description: Modifies a server. > - The servers in the maintenance status are unavailable for new user accesses.

UpdateServerGroup.name: UpdateServerGroup
UpdateServerGroup.description: Modifies a server group. - > Modifying the image, system disk size, and OU of a server group takes effect only on new servers. Modifying the max. number of sessions resets the routing calculation for new server group accesses from users.

UpdateShareFolderAssignment.name: UpdateShareFolderAssignment
UpdateShareFolderAssignment.description: Adds or removes shared directory members in batches.

UpdateUserFolderAssignment.name: UpdateUserFolderAssignment
UpdateUserFolderAssignment.description: Creates a personal storage directory. If the directory already exists, only the policy is updated and the directory is not created repeatedly.

UpdateWarehouseApp.name: UpdateWarehouseApp
UpdateWarehouseApp.summary: Modifying Specified Application Information in the Application Repository
UpdateWarehouseApp.description: Modifies specified application information in the application repository.

UploadWarehouseAppIcon.name: UploadWarehouseAppIcon
UploadWarehouseAppIcon.summary: Uploading an Icon File to the Application Repository
UploadWarehouseAppIcon.description: Uploads an icon file to the application repository.

ValidateServerGroup.name: ValidateServerGroup
ValidateServerGroup.description: Checks whether a server group meets the specified rules. 1. Checks whether a server group name meets the naming rules. 2. Checks whether a server group name is duplicate.
